title: Causal test of the land-allocation hypothesis (follow-up on Phase 5)
verdict_explanation: No intervention variant was built or evaluated. The mandatory baseline-representativeness check (this phase's methodology step 1, an explicit fix for Phase 4B's documented mistake) failed for both plausible current-champion candidates before any variant was constructed.

candidates_tested.note: latest submitted candidate (Sep 8), supersedes V3_12 per commit 86b4735

baseline_representativeness_check.result: FAILED -- both candidates reach land tier 2+ in 100% of tested games (0 misses across 88 total games), 40 points off Phase 5's measured 59.3%. Not sampling noise.
baseline_representativeness_check.explanation_evidenced: Replays/Auto/mine spans episode IDs 89,895,943-106,840,046 (median 103,520,461); Kaggle episode IDs increase monotonically over time, so roughly half of Phase 5's 150-game sample predates the current chassis substantially. Spot-checked 3 games where the champion's seat never expanded (episodes 90705157, 97456908, 90568571) -- all in the lower/older half of that range. Phase 5's 59.3% figure is a mixture statistic across Grace's whole play history, not a property of the current champion specifically.

pre_registered_predictions_note: Not applicable -- no variant was built, so no predictions were tested. Per methodology step 1, proceeding to build a variant against a non-representative baseline was explicitly avoided.
relationship_to_phase5: Does not weaken Phase 5's PARTIAL_EVIDENCE verdict (the real-replay reach-rate gap and the RNG_INDEPENDENT engine-gate finding both stand). Adds a scope correction: Phase 5's finding describes Grace's play history as a whole, not a live behavioral property of the current champion that a present-day intervention could move (current candidates already reach 100% reach rate; there is no gap left to explain in the current policy).
recommendation: None -- diagnostic only. If land-allocation timing remains of interest, a forward-looking replay-mining pass restricted to games played specifically by the current champion (once enough exist) would be the valid next step, not a causal intervention against this mixture-history baseline.
